_comment: Real humanloop project-export shape — based on their public docs (humanloop.com/docs/api-reference/projects). Captures both the single-project shape AND the multi-project archive shape via the projects[] array (this file uses single-project; multi-project test fixture is inline in the test file). Used to catch schema-shift regressions when humanloop bumps their export format.
name: Customer Support Bot
description: Tier-1 customer support — refund + password + general queries

prompts.name: main_response
prompts.template: You are a helpful customer support agent for {{company}}. Respond to: {{user_query}}

prompts.name: escalation
prompts.template: The customer ({{user_name}}) reported: {{issue}}. Determine if escalation is needed.

inputs.user_query: How do I reset my password?
I want a refund for order #12345
My account is locked, please help
